title: Trend Micro Control Manager task_controller Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to leak sensitive information on vulnerable installations of Trend Micro Control Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within task_controller.php. The url parameter does not properly sanitize the path supplied. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose arbitrary files from the system.
